column1: # The 65 Globals declared INSIDE a Type of the main module (__bb_main guarded Globals #0..#64).
# bcc initialises a Type's own Globals just before it registers that Type, which is where
# __bb_main has them. assemble.py declares each inside its owner and qualifies every use
# outside the owner as Owner.name. also_named: other corpus names for the same slot.
